howToPlay.intro: Super Auto Dwarves is a game about recruiting sturdy dwarves and fighting nasty monsters. Each day begins at camp, where you spend your gold recruiting dwarves. Each night your dwarves battle foul monsters, a little deeper and a little tougher each time. How long can you survive?
howToPlay.recruitingGold: You start every day with 10 gold. Gold you don't spend doesn't carry over, so use it!
howToPlay.recruitingCost: Each dwarf costs 3 gold. To recruit one, drag it from the Characters section of the shop into one of the 7 slots in your roster, or click it and then click a slot.
howToPlay.recruitingInfo: Dwarves have different stats, classes and abilities. To learn more about one, hover over it or select it, then click its "i" button.
howToPlay.promotingBody: Drop a dwarf from the shop onto an identical dwarf in your roster to promote it: it gains 1 experience point, +1 attack and +1 HP. When it has enough experience to level up, its ability gets stronger.
howToPlay.rosterMovesIntro: Pick up a dwarf in your roster and every other dwarf splits in two. Drop it where you want it (or click the dwarf, then click where it should go):
howToPlay.swapItem: Swap: drop it on the top half of another dwarf to swap their places, or on an empty slot to move it there.
howToPlay.mergeItem: Merge: drop it on the bottom half of an identical dwarf. The target gains all of the other dwarf's experience, plus one, and frees up a slot. A level 5 dwarf can't take any more.
howToPlay.sellItem: Sell: drop it on the sack of gold to the left of your roster for 1 gold.
howToPlay.lineUpBody: Order matters: your dwarves fight one at a time, starting from the front of your roster (its right-hand end). When you're ready, click To battle.
howToPlay.fightBody: The battle plays out on its own. The two front fighters strike each other at the same time; anyone brought to 0 HP drops, and the next in line steps up. Some abilities fire before the fighting starts, or at the start of each turn.
howToPlay.fightEnding: The battle ends when one side has no one left. If your dwarves are wiped out, it's game over. If both sides fall together, it's a draw, and you live to fight another day.
howToPlay.watchingBody: Use the Autoplay buttons (Slow or Fast) to let the battle run, or set it to Off and click Advance to step through it at your own pace.
